scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: The threshold is proved analytically from orbit simplices and strict distance inequalities. No finite experiment is used as proof of the all-radii statement.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.limitations: The result classifies connectivity of the reflection-fixed locus for the strict-diameter Vietoris–Rips complex of the full geodesic circle. It does not classify the full equivariant homotopy type or finite equivariant topological-complexity values for radii above 2π/3.

title: The exact reflection-fixed connectivity threshold in the circle Rips filtration
